description: This file contains test harness utilities and mock functions for testing the BlueBubbles extension, including API status mocks, account resolution, and fetch hook installation.

methods.name: mockBlueBubblesPrivateApiStatus
methods.description: Mocks the return value of the BlueBubbles private API status mock.

methods.name: mockBlueBubblesPrivateApiStatusOnce
methods.description: Mocks a one-time return value for the BlueBubbles private API status mock.

methods.name: resolveBlueBubblesAccountFromConfig
methods.description: Resolves a BlueBubbles account configuration from provided parameters.

methods.name: createBlueBubblesAccountsMockModule
methods.description: Creates a mock module for BlueBubbles account resolution.

methods.name: createBlueBubblesProbeMockModule
methods.description: Creates a mock module for BlueBubbles probe status.

methods.name: installBlueBubblesFetchTestHooks
methods.description: Installs fetch test hooks with mocked fetch and API status.

methods.name: createBlueBubblesFetchGuardPassthroughInstaller
methods.description: Creates a fetch guard installer that passes through fetch requests.
